payload.subject: Re: Follow-up question
payload.body:
hi — thanks for checking in. i want to give you an accurate update before we decide on a visit, so i'll follow up shortly with how the cough has been since the weekend.

if it seems worth booking, i'll reach out to schedule.

thanks

value.rationale: The memory slice is empty, so there is no factual basis for reporting whether the cough improved — this is a holding reply only, and the parent should confirm or replace it with the actual symptom update.
